title: (LEAD) FC Seoul crowned K League 1 champions
caption:
After a decade-long wait, FC Seoul has secured the K League 1 title before the season even reached its final stretch. Under head coach Kim Gi-dong, the squad dominated both ends of the pitch to break a nine-year championship run by Jeonbuk and Ulsan.
